Coalescing Anguishes can be found throughout the zone where a target is being hunted for Prey. They come in multiple sizes (Minor and Major), are marked on the minimap with the icon. The Coiled Stargorger Lure is a fishing lure utilized by anglers on the Coiled Isle, off the coast of Zul'Aman. Using these lures is the only way to catch Stargorgers. The recipe to create them can be purchased from Second Mate Sluggs at the cost of 1500 Voidlight Marl after achieving the Cursed Angler reputation rank. These lures are created with starfish that can also be caught in the waters of the Isle (, , and ), with the rarity of the starfish contributing to the number of lures created. Five Asteroids create one lure, five Benthoses create two lures, and five Polygons create six lures.
Coiled Stargorger is a fish that can only be caught in a Torrential Gorgerswarm within the waters of the Coiled Isle, created through use of a Coiled Stargorger Lure.

Collector Dyna is an earthen located southwest of Freywold Village on the Isle of Dorn.
Comfortable Itinerants are goblins located in Slam Central Station in the Undermine.

Colton is a goblin located at the G.E.T.A. Headquarters and at Hovel Hill in the Undermine. He is a member of G.E.T.A. and helped adventurers in hunting down a radioactive rat that was chased into a nearby sewer and had become highly aggressive.

__NOTOC__ Comically Large Magnet is a curio for Brann Bronzebeard during The War Within Season 2. The baseline version is found in low-tier delves, and higher-rank versions are found in higher-tier delves, all the way up to the Rank 4 version in Tier 8 delves.

Commander's Seal of the Dawn was a planned upgrade to Crusader's Seal of the Dawn. On 10 March 2025, Blizzard announced that the Seal of the Dawn would cap at rank 7, leaving this version unavailable.
Colossal Lifetether drops from Loom'ithar in Manaforge Omega.
Combative Negotiators are brokers located in Tazavesh, the Veiled Market in K'aresh.
